digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI workflow and change classification
propositions: Documentation-only changes must execute a reduced Verify lane with docs gates only, skipping OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs.

A trusted classifier must route based on changed paths, execute only from origin/main with no patchset-controlled logic, and fail-closed to full Verify on any uncertainty or parent-resolution failure.
Shared documentation gates must be extracted into a single composite action without duplication, retaining ADR, index, cross-reference, quickstart, drift, and CLI reference validation.
Classifier job failure must trigger full-route fallback jobs and still block Verified +1 to preserve fail-closed integrity.
All existing workflow-structure tests must follow extracted gates and classify logic without losing assertions or documentation coverage.
